To be honest, my personal experience at Syncfusion has been very positive. Before joining, I read several reviews online and initially felt that it might be difficult to survive here. I imagined the work environment would be extremely challenging and stressful. However, my actual experience turned out to be quite different.

🔹 Training Process

The company provides around 1 to 1.5 months of intensive training before assigning engineers to projects. Yes, during the training period, sleep can be limited because of the learning curve and assessments. But that phase is purely focused on building strong technical fundamentals.

Unlike many companies that hire and then wait for projects to assign employees, Syncfusion already has ready projects and prepares engineers in advance through structured training.

Importantly:

They do not force or pressure you aggressively.

They teach the concepts and then give assessments.

Your performance depends mainly on your own effort and willingness to learn.

The only expectation from employees is a strong learning mindset and eagerness to grow in their careers.

🔹 Role Allocation & Growth

Based on technical performance (and also soft skills), engineers are assigned to product teams. One strong assurance is that everyone in the training batch is given a Developer role.

In my batch of around 68 members, all were placed in developer roles based on the technology stack they performed best in. If someone performed better in another stack compared to their initial one, they were reassigned accordingly.

The company clearly values performance over seniority when giving positions.

🔹 Work-Life Balance

During the initial training period, I personally did not have good work-life balance. However, that was mainly due to my own eagerness to learn and my willingness to master new technologies.

After joining the product team:

I work 9 hours per day.

This includes 1 hour lunch and 30 minutes break.

Work-life balance is stable and manageable.
Work From Home Policy
During training, it follows company policy (generally office-based).
After training, hybrid WFH is provided.
After confirmation, employees are eligible for full Work From Home.
This flexibility is a strong advantage.

🔹 Company Culture

Engineers are respected.

The company does not eliminate employees just because they struggle initially.

Even if someone finds it difficult during training, as long as they show willingness and effort to learn, the company supports them.

One thing that impressed me deeply:
If someone wants to leave the company, management genuinely tries to understand the reason. They ask whether it is due to learning difficulties, health issues, workplace problems, or anything else. Only if the employee still wishes to leave do they accept it. I personally witnessed this with a colleague, and it showed me how much they care about employees.

🔹 Salary & Policies

Engineers receive a hike every 6 months.

Policies are similar to most IT companies.

Snacks are provided (not full meals).

No frequent corporate events or large functions.

Formal dress code is mandatory (shirt, formal shoes, etc.).

Final Thoughts

For freshers, Syncfusion is an excellent place to start a career and build strong technical foundations. If you are selected, attend the training with an open mind and strong effort — you will benefit greatly.

Before talking about technology, Mr. Kumar and his team took the time to understand our business objectives, future vision, and the challenges we were trying to solve.

As our platform evolved, we requested support for integrating additional medically certified devices for both the USA and Indian healthcare markets. Once again, the team exceeded our expectations. They also shared a well-planned integration framework that gave us a clear vision for future expansion. Instead of delivering only what we requested, they consistently suggested improvements that added real value to our project.

Another major strength of iStudio Technologies is their expertise in Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies. Their ability to combine healthcare knowledge with AI-driven innovation gives us confidence that our platform is being built with the future in mind. Because of this positive experience, we have already decided to collaborate with them on another project aimed at the global market.

The reason we're sharing this review in such detail is simple. Finding a software development company that is technically strong, transparent, responsive, and genuinely committed to a client's success has become increasingly difficult. However, the experience is badly let down by two major issues.

First, there is a serious pest menace throughout the premises, especially in the cafeteria. Cockroaches/pests can be seen around mugs, plates, the coffee machine, and other common-use areas. This is completely unacceptable for a professional workspace where people are expected to eat, drink, and spend long working hours. Hygiene in shared spaces should be a basic priority, not something members have to repeatedly worry about.

Second, the security experience was extremely disappointing and insensitive. My wife and kids had come to surprise me while I was working late. Unfortunately, I did not have my Access card with me that day. Instead of handling the situation sensibly, the security staff refused to allow them inside and kept insisting that visitors are not allowed after 7 PM and that someone from my office had to come out and let us in. This made absolutely no sense because I was the only person from my office working at that time. The security staff could have verified the situation or used the usual access process but instead chose to be rigid and unhelpful.

Because of this, my family had to leave, and what was supposed to be a happy surprise turned into a very upsetting experience. Rules are important, but common sense and basic courtesy are equally important, especially when dealing with members and their families.

Overall, while the place looks good and has decent workstations, the pest problem and the poor handling by security make the experience very disappointing.
